moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 7-13, marking its 20th non-consecutive week at the top.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it a massive 20 non-consecutive weeks at UK Number 1. What a run! #UKChart

angles.name: Chart History
angles.copy: History makers! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean has now spent 20 non-consecutive weeks at UK Number 1. Are you still streaming it?

moments.title: The Weeknd's Wembley Residency
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his five-night 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour residency at Wembley Stadium in London, running from August 14-19.

angles.name: Wembley Night 1

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London is buzzing! The Weeknd's massive stadium tour is underway at Wembley. Expect incredible visuals and all the hits. Are you there?

moments.title: Happy 66th to Sarah Brightman
moments.blurb: English classical crossover soprano and actress Sarah Brightman, known for her roles in West End musicals and her global music career, turns 66 today.

angles.name: Soprano Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the incredible Sarah Brightman! From West End stages to global classical crossover icon, what's your favourite Sarah Brightman performance?

angles.name: Phantom Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the original Christine Daaé! Sarah Brightman's voice continues to enchant. Celebrate her birthday with a classic track!

moments.title: Maddy Prior turns 79
moments.blurb: Maddy Prior, the influential English folk rock singer best known as the lead vocalist of Steeleye Span, celebrates her 79th birthday today.

angles.name: Folk Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the legendary Maddy Prior of Steeleye Span! A true icon of English folk rock. Which Steeleye Span song is on your playlist today?

angles.name: Steeleye Span Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating Maddy Prior's 79th birthday today! Her distinctive voice shaped Steeleye Span's sound and influenced generations of folk musicians. Send your birthday wishes!

moments.title: Larry Graham is 80 Today
moments.blurb: Larry Graham Jr., the innovative bassist from Sly and the Family Stone and founder of Graham Central Station, celebrates his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Funk Bass Legend
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the one and only Larry Graham! The man who invented the slap bass technique and brought us the grooves of Sly & The Family Stone and Graham Central Station. What a legend!

angles.name: Music Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating a true music pioneer, Larry Graham, on his 80th birthday! His 'thumpin' and pluckin'' changed bass playing forever. Tune in for some funk classics!

moments.title: Mark Collins of The Charlatans turns 61

angles.name: Britpop Guitarist
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Mark Collins, the brilliant guitarist from The Charlatans! Your riffs defined an era. What's your favourite Charlatans track?

angles.name: Charlatans Sound
angles.copy: Celebrating Mark Collins' 61st today! His guitar work is integral to The Charlatans' iconic sound. Send your birthday wishes to the Britpop hero!
